headline: A beach beneath a bridge. And that's just the start.
dek: Six memorable corners of the Amalfi Coast
editorial_intent: Lead with the extraordinary real Fiordo di Furore bridge-and-cove visual, followed by five distinct licensed Amalfi Coast landscapes, instead of a generic Positano opening and filler CTA.
reader_scenario: A traveller browsing an inspiring Italy photo gallery, who can manually swipe beautiful scenes and save the real place names.
share_reason: The visually unexpected cove under a coastal bridge creates a concrete reason to open and share the carousel, while each of the following five slides adds a distinct saveable location or experience.
slide_count_rationale: Six real 4:5 photos: dramatic Fiordo di Furore cover; Ravello gardens; Path of the Gods coastal view; Positano streetscape; Amalfi beach; and Amalfi waterfront from offshore. All six offer destination value, no generic closing card.
caption:
There’s a beach tucked beneath a road bridge on Italy’s Amalfi Coast — and it’s only one of the places worth seeing. 🍋

📍 Fiordo di Furore — a turquoise cove framed by cliffs and an arched bridge.
📍 Ravello — garden terraces perched high above the coastline.
📍 Path of the Gods — an unforgettable hillside view towards Positano.
📍 Positano — tightly packed pastel houses above the sea.
📍 Amalfi Beach — colourful umbrellas beneath the old town.
📍 Amalfi from the water — the dramatic coastline seen from offshore.

Which would you go to first? Save this for a future Italian escape.

Photos: Rolands Varsbergs, nella n., Sekwang Chia, Ian Mackey, Margo Evardson & Barbora Dostálová / Unsplash.
